summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

Also run the procedure 'billing_amount_migration' in between other work; run its steps in order, one at a time.

Never remove a response field from ledgerly; mark it deprecated and retain it for at least 180 days after its first deprecation notice.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py causing customer 400s. Pagination work is paused/superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Recent work
Billing migration reached step 5: migration mismatch count was zero, then `amount_cents` was made `NOT NULL`. Added comprehensive currency-rounding tests; full suite passed (184 passed, 2 skipped), and Ruff passed. The unrelated prior invoice-rounding failure was resolved. Webhook signature verification remains unresolved.
